messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Added **Deal name** under **Reproduce a game**. Names now survive saving and loading. Fixed pasted saves rejected because their JSON fields appeared in a different order; legacy saves and replays remain compatible.

Build, type checks, and 148 unit tests pass. All 81 browser checks passed across the full run and artwork retry, after extending that test’s timeout.

Changed files pass formatting. The repository-wide check still flags 13 untouched files.
